passage.label: Righteous among gardens happiness; rejoicing Lord given protected punishment Hellfire; eat drink satisfaction used do; reclining arranged couches marry fair women large beautiful eyes; believed descendants followed faith join descendants not deprive anything deeds every person earned retained; provide fruit meat whatever desire; exchange cup wine no ill speech commission sin; circulate servant boys especially pearls well-protected; approach one another inquiring; say indeed previously among people fearful; Allah conferred favor protected punishment Scorching Fire; indeed used supplicate Him before indeed Beneficent Merciful

arabicExcerpts.text: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ
يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ
۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

mainSubject.label: The righteous placed among gardens and happiness, rejoicing in their Lord's gift and His protection from Hellfire; eating and drinking in satisfaction for their prior deeds, reclining on arranged couches and married to fair large-eyed women; believing parents joined with their faithful descendants without any deed-deprivation since each person retains what they earned; provided with desired fruit and meat, exchanging cups free of ill speech or sin, served by pearl-like boys circulating especially for them; approaching one another in mutual inquiry, recalling their former fear of displeasing Allah and His conferred favour protecting them from the Scorching Fire, attributed to their prior supplication to the Beneficent Merciful

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the burn-patiently-or-impatiently verdict (16) before the righteous-reward block opens (17); P2 ends with the Beneficent-Merciful attribution (28) before the reminder-commission begins (29); P3 runs from that commission through the rhetorical challenges, sky-fragment dismissal, Day-of-unconsciousness and the closing timed-praise command (29-49).
